response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with strengths in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, but the role requires deep embedded C development on UNIX, Linux kernel source modification, L2/L3 networking security expertise, and native-level Japanese. He shows only brief C/C++ experience (National Instruments, 2014-2015), no evidence of kernel work, networking protocols, security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X, or embedded switch products, and lists no Japanese proficiency — a hard requirement. The gap on multiple mandatory qualifications makes him a poor fit despite strong general engineering skills.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience, exceeding the 3+ years requirement
Solid Linux familiarity and low-latency systems work (async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and technical mentoring
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — the role requires native-level Japanese
Minimal recent C experience and no Linux kernel investigation or modification background
No embedded networking, switch, or security technology experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded C / Linux kernel / networking security experience
Strong overall engineering experience and Linux/systems exposure
